name: Imotekh the Stormlord
oracle_text:
Phaeron — Whenever one or more artifact cards leave your graveyard, create two 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Grand Strategist — At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target artifact creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains menace until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Phaeron — Whenever one or more artifact cards leave your graveyard, create two 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.

needs.what: a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token (e.g. id necron_warrior_2_2_b_artifact)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Necron Warrior and no 2/2 black artifact creature token; the nearest, astartes_warrior_2_2_b_menace and zombie_2_2_b, have the wrong subtypes, are not artifacts, and the Astartes one has menace. The trigger half is expressible as a batched leaves_graveyard trigger filtered to artifact cards you own, and the Grand Strategist line is a begin_combat trigger with pump plus grant_keyword menace.
